effect: No Distractions and incoming flinch pipeline

oracle.used: Only Stability branch and weapon-family coefficients. Legacy Resilience branch explicitly replaced by current Health/ADS rule.

primary_context.claim: Historical Update 3.2.0 establishes 1 second / 35 percent No Distractions.
Armor 3.0 renames Resilience to Health and lists 0..10 percent flinch resistance.

algorithm.stability: S = clamp(base + eligible point modifiers followed by declared stat multipliers, 0, 100); multiplier = 1 - (S - 20)/80 * archetype_max_resistance
algorithm.health: H = clamp(character Health, 0, 200); multiplier = 1 - min(H,100)*0.001 while completed ADS, otherwise 1
algorithm.perk: No Distractions multiplier 0.65 while active and completed ADS
algorithm.angle: incoming signed degree input * Stability multiplier * Health multiplier * product(perk families); then native float/pitch bounds

policies: Normal quiet interval is one second from ADS input. Accepted shots during windup restart it; rejected shots do not. Once active, shooting does not remove the buff. Empty magazine is eligible. Release, stow and source removal clear the wait and benefit.

Enhanced interval is a required positive equipment parameter. Reference gear supplies 0.9 seconds, corroborated by current Clarity; Compendium retains a question mark, so this is explicit selected calibration rather than silently resolved certainty.

Completed ADS is the Chorus sampling boundary for Health and active perk resistance. The perk timer itself runs from input and may become ready while a long enter animation is pending. Exact original interpolation windows need calibration.
Current original Health rule takes precedence over Foundry legacy resilience. Original three-mod Unflinching factor is 0.65 rather than Foundry 0.6; the mod itself is not implemented in this change.

Explicit input tag and two typed impact angles are required. Positive shield/absorption/health loss can emit damage_taken; immune/cancelled/zero loss and undeclared damage do not invent a base angle. Dead/spectator/other host rejection remains an unapplied aim receipt.

The receiver calculates using the defending weapon origin but applies aim with original attacker provenance. Only one receiver is configured per weapon. Numeric same-perk, Health and Stability families deduplicate; future new content must not install duplicate receiver hooks.

The fixture uses a real independent rifle and helmet container. Base Stability 50, one damage, 2/-10 degree attack, 20 metre hitscan, ammunition/fire rate and ADS duration are synthetic acceptance inputs.

This does not calibrate base incoming flinch by attacker/receiver archetype, visual shake, recoil/recovery, aim assist, stagger, special exotic classification, production content/UI or physical-world restart.
